//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Giant Spawn -> Config

Enable Giant Spawn.//: Whether Giant Spawn is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

chanceSurfaceZombieIsGiant.//: The chance a zombie that has spawned on the surface is a giant. min: 0, max: 1

shouldBurnGiantsInDaylight.//: If enabled, burns giants when daylight shines upon them.

onlySpawnGiantOnSurface.//: If enabled, a giant will only spawn on the surface.

giantMovementSpeedModifier.//: The giant movement speed modifier relative to the base zombie movement speed. min: 0, max: 20

giantAttackDamageModifier.//: The giant attack damage modifier relative to the base zombie attack damage. min: 0, max: 20

giantMaxHealthModifier.//: The giant max health modifier relative to the base giant max health of 100. min: 0.1, max: 10

giantKnockbackResistance.//: How much knockback a giant ignores, from 0 (none) to 1 (all). min: 0, max: 1

giantFollowRange.//: The range in blocks in which a giant finds and follows its target. min: 0, max: 128

giantExperienceReward.//: The amount of experience a giant drops when it is killed by a player. min: 0, max: 10,000

chanceGiantSpawnsWithEquipment.//: The chance a giant spawns with a set of armor and a sword or shovel. min: 0, max: 1

giantsUseZombieSounds.//: If enabled, giants make the sounds of a zombie, at a lower pitch.

giantDropItems.//: The items a giant drops when it dies, each with an amount or a range. For example: 'minecraft:rotten_flesh=4-20,minecraft:iron_ingot=1'.

dimensionsToSpawnIn.//: Dimensions in which zombies can turn into giants, separated by a comma. Leave empty for every dimension. For example: 'minecraft:overworld'.

biomesToSpawnIn.//: Biomes in which zombies can turn into giants, separated by a comma. Biome tags work too, starting with a '#'. Leave empty for every biome. For example: 'minecraft:plains,#minecraft:is_forest'.
